--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LucasLehmer
theorem sModNat_eq_sMod (p k : ℕ) (hp : 2 ≤ p) : (sModNat (2 ^ p - 1) k : ℤ) = sMod p k := by
  have h1 := calc
    4 = 2 ^ 2 := by norm_num
    _ ≤ 2 ^ p := Nat.pow_le_pow_of_le_right (by norm_num) hp
  have h2 : 1 ≤ 2 ^ p := by omega
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    rw [sModNat, sMod, Int.ofNat_emod]
    simp [h2]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [sModNat, sMod, ← ih]
    have h3 : 2 ≤ 2 ^ p - 1 := by
      zify [h2]
      calc
        (2 : Int) ≤ 4 - 1 := by norm_num
        _         ≤ 2 ^ p - 1 := by zify at h1; exact Int.sub_le_sub_right h1 _
    zify [h2, h3]
    rw [← add_sub_assoc, sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, add_comm _ (-2), ← add_assoc,
      Int.add_emod_self, ← sub_eq_add_neg]

  rw [← sum_sdiff_lt_sum_sdiff]
  exact (Nat.geomSum_lt hn <| by simpa).trans_le <| single_le_sum (fun _ _ ↦ by positivity) <|
    mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hat, has⟩

theorem order_ineq (p' : ℕ) (h : lucasLehmerResidue (p' + 2) = 0) :
    2 ^ (p' + 2) < (q (p' + 2) : ℕ) ^ 2 :=
  calc
    2 ^ (p' + 2) = orderOf (ωUnit (p' + 2)) := (order_ω p' h).symm
    _ ≤ Fintype.card (X (q (p' + 2)))ˣ := orderOf_le_card_univ
    _ < (q (p' + 2) : ℕ) ^ 2 := card_units_lt (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt (two_lt_q _))

--src: Mathlib.SetTheory.Ordinal.Exponential
theorem log_eq_zero {b o : Ordinal} (hbo : o < b) : log b o = 0 := by
  rcases eq_or_ne o 0 with (rfl | ho)
  · exact log_zero_right b
  rcases le_or_lt b 1 with hb | hb
  · rcases le_one_iff.1 hb with (rfl | rfl)
    · exact log_zero_left o
    · exact log_one_left o
  · rwa [← Ordinal.le_zero, ← lt_succ_iff, succ_zero, ← lt_opow_iff_log_lt hb ho, opow_one]
